name: Akita Prefecture: 森づくり県民提案事業 (Water and Green forest tax)

funder.name: Akita Prefecture (Forest Environment Conservation Division, 水と緑の森づくり税)

summary: Subsidy from Akita's forest tax for citizen-run forest projects in the prefecture: tree planting, brush clearing, forest learning and clearing overgrown satoyama woods near homes to deter bears. Open to NPOs, companies, community and volunteer groups; up to JPY 400,000 per group, JPY 1m for bear projects.

amount.note: Per group at 100% of eligible costs; up to 1,000,000 yen for bear-related forest work

reporting: Results report under the grant rules
